paper_title: Search for sub-eV axion-like particles in a quasi-parallel stimulated resonant photon-photon collider with "coronagraphy"
coupling_convention: g/M (ALP-photon coupling) in GeV^-1, plotted directly
notes: Laboratory stimulated resonant photon-photon collider (SAPPHIRES02) search for sub-eV ALPs, model-independent (no DM density). Result reported as ALP-photon coupling g/M in GeV^-1 vs ALP mass m. Only one explicit numerical exclusion point given in text: g/M = 5.45e-7 GeV^-1 at m = 0.15 eV (95% CL) for pseudoscalar ALPs; full exclusion curve (Figs 10/11) spans ~1e-3 to 1 eV but numerical values not tabulated.
